Both assistants provide accurate, simplified explanations of language models and correctly identify that they are trained on unlabeled data. Assistant B edges out Assistant A by including concrete examples of applications (voice assistants, machine translation, predictive text) which makes the concept more relatable and trustworthy for a non-technical audience. It also ends with an open invitation for follow-up questions, which aligns well with the customer-facing role described in the prompt.
